responsibility: Declares the Rust backend helpers for compiling patterns in three different roles: match case labels, scrutinee binding extraction, and let-statement destructuring. The interfaces separate control-flow label generation from binding setup and local initialization, and define the visitor coverage and unsupported-pattern diagnostics used by statement and expression lowering.
same_name_distinction: Collects the declarations for three distinct pattern-lowering helpers—case labels, match bindings, and let destructuring. Unlike rust-compile-pattern.cc, it defines the public visitor classes, entry points, and unsupported-pattern diagnostics rather than the concrete lowering operations.
